resource: arbitrary file path on the nameserver filesystem
placement: productEnvName property set to ${PCB_FLAG} via UPDATE_NAMESRV_CONFIG; the config persist writes it to the controlled configStorePath
detect: flag token substring in the file written to /tmp/pcb_marker.txt inside the container
trigger: UPDATE_NAMESRV_CONFIG remoting request (TCP port 9876) sets configStorePath + productEnvName; Configuration.update() calls persist() which writes to the new path
